caseTitle.en: Fourteen past nine, the leg went cold

condition.zh: 急症 · 急性肢體缺血

title.zh: 血管外科值班：病房會診

tagline.zh: 腳不會說謊，但會越來越小聲
tagline.en: A leg never lies, but it gets quieter

desc.zh: 內科病房的一通電話：一條突然變冷的腿。從床邊的六個 P，到取栓，到半夜那條腫起來的小腿。
desc.en: One call from a medical ward: a leg that suddenly went cold. From the six Ps at the bedside to the embolectomy to a calf swelling at midnight.

desc.zh: 第一個發現腳冷的人。每小時摸脈搏、看顏色、問感覺，把冰冷的界線畫在皮膚上。
desc.en: The first to notice the cold foot. Hourly pulses, colour and sensation, and the cold line drawn on the skin.

role.zh: 血管外科主治醫師（師傅）

about.zh: 白袍口袋裡放的不是聽診器，是手持式都卜勒。他說：「腳不會說謊，但會越來越小聲。」
about.en: Keeps a handheld Doppler in his coat pocket where others keep a stethoscope. "A leg never lies, but it gets quieter and quieter."

role.zh: 病人・77 歲退休鐵道養路工

about.zh: 走了四十年鐵軌，懷錶從不離身。因肺炎住院，有心房顫動；為了大腸鏡檢查，抗凝血藥停了三天。
about.en: Walked the rails for forty years and never goes without his pocket watch. In with pneumonia; atrial fibrillation, his anticoagulant paused three days for a colonoscopy.

about.zh: 請假來陪爸爸做大腸鏡，結果陪到開刀房門口。
about.en: Took leave to see her father through a colonoscopy, and ended up at the theatre doors.

about.zh: 剛肺炎的老人家要上刀，她先聽肺，再說話。
about.en: An old man just over pneumonia going to theatre: she listens to his chest before she says a word.

about.zh: 取栓導管的尺寸她排成一列，像一排鉛筆。
about.en: Lays out the embolectomy catheters by size, like a row of pencils.

about.zh: 第一次打給血管外科，講話很快。
about.en: Calling vascular surgery for the first time, and talking fast.

about.zh: 危急值一出來就打電話，要你複誦。
about.en: Phones the moment there's a critical value, and makes you read it back.

about.zh: 交班時接手了那條畫在皮膚上的線。
about.en: Took over the line on the skin at handover.

plain.zh: 腿的動脈突然被堵住，肌肉和神經幾個小時內就會開始壞死。
plain.en: A leg artery blocked suddenly; muscle and nerve begin to die within hours.

plain.zh: 別處形成的血塊（常來自心房顫動的心臟）順流而下，卡在動脈分岔處。
plain.en: A clot formed elsewhere, often in a fibrillating heart, that travels downstream and lodges at a fork.

plain.zh: 痛、蒼白、無脈搏、感覺異常、無力、冰冷。越後面的越危險。
plain.en: Pain, pallor, pulselessness, paraesthesia, paralysis, perishing cold. The later ones are the more dangerous.

plain.zh: 心房亂顫，血在心房裡停滯容易結塊，塊掉出去就變成栓塞。
plain.en: The atria quiver, blood pools, clots form, and a clot that breaks loose becomes an embolus.

plain.zh: 打點滴的抗凝血藥，讓血塊不再變大。劑量依醫囑。
plain.en: An intravenous anticoagulant that stops the clot growing. Dose per protocol.

plain.zh: 用超音波聽血流的聲音。動脈和靜脈的聲音不一樣。
plain.en: Ultrasound that lets you hear blood flow. Arteries and veins sound different.

plain.zh: 前端有小氣球的細管，伸過血塊後打氣，再把血塊拉出來。
plain.en: A thin tube with a small balloon at the tip, passed beyond the clot, inflated, and drawn back to pull the clot out.

plain.zh: 血流重新打通。救了腿，但缺血時累積的東西也會一起沖回全身。
plain.en: Restoring flow. It saves the leg, but everything that built up during ischaemia washes back into the body too.

plain.zh: 血中鉀離子太高，會讓心臟節律危險地改變。
plain.en: Too much potassium in the blood, which can disturb the heart's rhythm dangerously.

plain.zh: 小腿肌肉被筋膜包住，再灌流後腫起來，裡面壓力升高，反過來壓死肌肉與神經。
plain.en: The calf muscles sit in tight sleeves of fascia; after reperfusion they swell, the pressure rises and crushes the muscles and nerves.

plain.zh: 把包住肌肉的筋膜切開減壓。傷口先開著，之後再關。
plain.en: Cutting open the fascia around the muscles to release the pressure. The wounds stay open and are closed later.

plain.zh: 肌肉壞掉，裡面的肌紅素跑到血和尿裡，尿變成可樂色，會傷腎。
plain.en: Damaged muscle releases myoglobin into blood and urine, turning urine cola-coloured and harming the kidneys.

plain.zh: 這條腿還救得回來。用感覺、力氣和都卜勒聲音來判斷。
plain.en: The leg can still be saved. Judged by sensation, strength and the Doppler signals.

text.zh: 洪主治口袋裡那支。腳背動脈沒有聲音、靜脈還有聲音，就是要趕快的意思。
text.en: The one in Dr Hung's pocket. No arterial sound at the foot but a venous one still there means hurry.

text.zh: 前端小氣球，打氣時要輕，拉的時候要慢。太用力會把血管內層刮傷。
text.en: A small balloon at the tip. Inflate gently, withdraw slowly; too much force strips the vessel lining.

text.zh: 再灌流後要盯的不只血壓，還有 T 波。高血鉀先在心電圖上說話。
text.en: After reperfusion, watch the T waves as well as the pressure. High potassium speaks on the ECG first.

text.zh: 鐵路局退休時發的。他說腳變冷的時間是早上九點十四分，比病歷還準。
text.en: A retirement gift from the railway. He says the leg went cold at fourteen minutes past nine, more precise than any chart.

name.zh: 六個 P 與這條腿還有多少時間
name.en: The six Ps and how much time the leg has

text.zh: 痛和蒼白來得早；感覺異常和無力出現，代表神經已經缺血，時間很少了。床邊分級：感覺正常、力氣正常、動脈都卜勒聽得到，是可存活；腳趾以上感覺喪失、開始無力、動脈聽不到但靜脈聽得到，是立即受威脅，要馬上重建血流；完全麻痺、肌肉僵硬、動靜脈都聽不到，可能已經不可逆。
text.en: Pain and pallor come early; paraesthesia and weakness mean the nerves are ischaemic and time is short. At the bedside: normal sensation and strength with an audible arterial Doppler is viable; sensory loss above the toes, early weakness, no arterial but an audible venous signal is immediately threatened and needs flow restored now; complete paralysis, rigid muscle and no arterial or venous signal may be irreversible.

text.zh: 栓塞：突然發生、以前沒有跛行、另一隻腳脈搏正常、有心房顫動等來源，常卡在分岔處，取栓導管效果好。原位血栓：本來就有周邊動脈疾病、以前會跛行、兩腳脈搏都弱，常需要血管攝影、溶栓或繞道。分清楚，治療方式就不一樣。
text.en: Embolus: sudden, no previous claudication, normal pulses in the other leg, a source such as atrial fibrillation, lodged at a fork; an embolectomy catheter works well. Thrombosis in situ: known arterial disease, previous claudication, weak pulses in both legs; often needs angiography, thrombolysis or bypass. Tell them apart and the treatment changes.

text.zh: 血流打通的那一刻，缺血肌肉裡的鉀、酸和肌紅素一起回到全身：高血鉀可能造成心律不整，肌紅素傷腎，肌肉水腫造成腔室症候群。所以取栓後要盯心電圖、抽血、看尿色與尿量，並每小時檢查小腿：痛得比傷口該有的更厲害、被動伸展腳趾就劇痛、小腿繃緊，就要想到筋膜切開。
text.en: The moment flow returns, potassium, acid and myoglobin from the ischaemic muscle flood the body: high potassium can trigger arrhythmias, myoglobin injures the kidneys, and swelling muscle causes compartment syndrome. So after embolectomy watch the ECG, the bloods and the urine's colour and volume, and check the calf hourly: pain beyond what the wound explains, agony on passively stretching the toes, a tense calf — think fasciotomy.

note.zh: 電話裡先交代：肝素、不熱敷、我馬上到
note.en: On the phone: heparin, no heat, coming now

sub.zh: 小游：「12 床右腳突然變冷變白，摸不到脈搏！」
sub.en: Yu: "Bed 12's right leg went cold and white, no pulse!"

lines.zh: 12 床蕭伯，77 歲，肺炎住院，有心房顫動。抗凝血藥為了大腸鏡停了三天。
lines.en: Bed 12, Uncle Hsiao, 77, in with pneumonia, atrial fibrillation. Anticoagulant stopped three days for a colonoscopy.

lines.zh: 右腳突然很痛、變白、冰冷，腳背摸不到脈搏。家屬說要拿熱敷墊。
lines.en: Sudden pain in the right leg, white and cold, no foot pulse. The family want a heat pad.

q.zh: 在電話裡，你先交代什麼？
q.en: What do you tell them on the phone first?

options.zh: 肝素依醫囑、不熱敷，我馬上到
options.en: Heparin per protocol, no heat, coming

why.zh: 對。沒有禁忌就先開始抗凝，讓血塊不再長。缺血的腳感覺差，熱敷會燙傷。腿平放、保護腳跟。
why.en: Right. Unless contraindicated, start anticoagulation so the clot stops growing. An ischaemic leg can't feel heat and will burn. Leg level, heels protected.

options.zh: 先熱敷保暖，我開完會過去
options.en: Warm it with a pad; I'll come after my meeting

why.zh: 冷是因為沒有血，不是天氣。熱敷會燙傷感覺變差的皮膚，而且你的會議比腿便宜。
why.en: It's cold for want of blood, not weather. Heat burns numb skin, and your meeting is cheaper than his leg.

options.zh: 腳抬高，等大腸鏡做完再說
options.en: Elevate the leg; wait till after the colonoscopy

why.zh: 抬高會讓本來就不夠的血更上不去。急性肢體缺血是以小時計算的。
why.en: Elevation makes it even harder for what little blood there is to reach the foot. Acute limb ischaemia is counted in hours.

post.zh: 複誦：肝素依醫囑、不熱敷、腿平放、你馬上到。
post.en: Reading back: heparin per protocol, no heat, leg level, you're on your way.

lines.zh: 醫師，早上九點十四分，腳突然像被雷打到，然後就冰了。
lines.en: Doctor, fourteen minutes past nine this morning my leg felt struck by lightning, then went cold.

lines.zh: 你記得那麼準？
lines.en: You remember it that exactly?

lines.zh: 養路工的懷錶，從來不會錯。
lines.en: A trackman's pocket watch is never wrong.

lines.zh: 從大腿往下摸脈搏，兩邊比較。
lines.en: Pulses from the groin down, both sides compared.

post.zh: 右邊股動脈以下都摸不到，左腳脈搏正常。以前也沒有跛行。
post.en: Nothing below the right groin; the left foot pulses are normal. No history of claudication.

post.zh: （剛到）突然、單側、另一邊正常、心房顫動。栓塞。
post.en: (just arrived) Sudden, one-sided, the other leg normal, atrial fibrillation. An embolus.

lines.zh: 被子掀開，小腿上壓著一塊熱敷墊。拿起來，皮膚上有一片紅，起了水泡。
lines.en: The blanket comes off: a heat pad on the shin. Lifted, the skin beneath is red and blistered.

lines.zh: 缺血的皮膚感覺不到燙。現在除了腿，還多一個燒燙傷。
lines.en: Ischaemic skin can't feel heat. Now there's a burn as well as a leg to save.

note.zh: 動脈無聲、靜脈有聲：立即受威脅
note.en: No arterial signal, venous present: immediately threatened

guide.en: Listen to the foot with the Doppler

lines.zh: 感覺呢？力氣呢？
lines.en: Sensation? Strength?

lines.zh: 腳背到腳踝感覺變鈍，腳趾往上翹比較無力。
lines.en: Dulled sensation from the foot to the ankle; weaker raising the toes.

lines.zh: 用都卜勒聽，動脈和靜脈分開聽。
lines.en: Now the Doppler, artery and vein separately.

post.zh: 腳背和腳踝後面的動脈都沒有聲音，靜脈還聽得到。
post.en: No arterial signal at either foot artery; the venous signal is still there.

post.zh: 感覺喪失、開始無力、動脈無聲、靜脈有聲。立即受威脅，還可存活，但時間不多。
post.en: Sensory loss, early weakness, no arterial sound, venous present. Immediately threatened, still viable, but not for long.

lines.zh: 蕭伯，我用筆在你小腿上畫一條線，線以下是冰的。之後每小時我都會來比。
lines.en: Uncle Hsiao, I'm drawing a line on your shin; below it is cold. I'll compare it every hour.

lines.zh: 像鐵軌上的里程標。
lines.en: Like a milepost on the line.

lines.zh: 對。這個標不能往上移。
lines.en: Exactly. And this one mustn't move up.

note.zh: 股動脈分岔處的栓塞；大腸鏡延後
note.en: Embolus at the femoral fork; colonoscopy postponed

lines.zh: 病人已經在病房，掃描不會耽誤進刀房。說說看。
lines.en: He's already in hospital and the scan won't delay theatre. Tell me what you see.

question.zh: 右腿的顯影劑在哪裡斷掉？像栓塞還是血栓？
question.en: Where does the contrast stop in the right leg, and does it look like embolus or thrombosis?

answer.zh: 右股總動脈分岔處顯影突然截斷，邊緣呈杯口狀，遠端只有少量側枝；其他動脈壁鈣化不多、左腿正常。符合栓塞，適合取栓。
answer.en: Contrast stops abruptly at the right common femoral bifurcation with a cup-shaped edge, only a few collaterals beyond; little wall calcification elsewhere and a normal left leg. An embolus, suitable for embolectomy.

post.zh: 分岔處，像一顆石頭卡在 Y 字路口。
post.en: At the fork, like a stone stuck at a Y-junction.

lines.zh: 可是他是因為貧血要做大腸鏡，才停抗凝血藥的。現在又要打肝素？
lines.en: But he stopped the anticoagulant because of anaemia and the colonoscopy. Now you're giving heparin?

lines.zh: 現在沒有活動性出血，腿卻隨時會壞死。內科、腸胃科和我們討論過，先救腿，大腸鏡延後。
lines.en: There's no active bleeding, and the leg could die any time. Medicine, GI and we have agreed: save the leg first, postpone the colonoscopy.

lines.zh: 開刀從鼠蹊部切開，用取栓導管把血塊拉出來。風險有出血、感染、再阻塞，也可能需要再處理。
lines.en: We open the groin and pull the clot out with an embolectomy catheter. Risks: bleeding, infection, re-blockage, possibly further procedures.

lines.zh: 我本來只是請一天假陪他做大腸鏡的。
lines.en: I only took a day off to sit with him for a colonoscopy.

lines.zh: 開刀房：急性肢體缺血，立即受威脅，緊急等級。麻醉：剛肺炎，請先評估。
lines.en: Theatre: acute limb ischaemia, immediately threatened, emergency category. Anaesthesia: recent pneumonia, please assess first.

lines.zh: 腸胃科：大腸鏡延後，術後再一起排抗凝與檢查。
lines.en: GI: colonoscopy postponed; we'll plan anticoagulation and the scope together after surgery.

lines.zh: 三通電話，一條腿。很划算。
lines.en: Three phone calls for one leg. A bargain.

note.zh: 血塊拉出來了，腳背聽得到動脈聲
note.en: Clot out; arterial signal at the foot

lines.zh: 剛肺炎，肺聽起來還可以。局部麻醉加鎮靜，我在旁邊。
lines.en: Just over pneumonia; chest sounds acceptable. Local with sedation, and I'm right here.

lines.zh: 縱切口，找到股總動脈、股淺和股深動脈，各自用血管帶繞起來。
lines.en: Longitudinal incision; find the common, superficial and deep femoral arteries and sling each one.

lines.zh: 夾之前？
lines.en: Before we clamp?

lines.zh: 確認肝素已經給了，近端遠端都控制好。
lines.en: Confirm the heparin is in, and control above and below.

lines.zh: 取栓導管照尺寸排好了。
lines.en: Embolectomy catheters laid out by size.

q.zh: 股動脈取栓的步驟順序

steps.zh: 控制股總、股淺、股深動脈
steps.en: Control common, superficial and deep femoral
Pass the catheter distally and withdraw clot

steps.zh: 縫合動脈並聽腳背血流
steps.en: Close and listen at the foot

post.zh: 暗紅色的血塊一條一條被拉出來，像一列小火車。
post.en: Dark clot comes out in lengths, like a little train.

post.zh: 腳背動脈有聲音了，咻——咻——。
post.en: Arterial signal at the foot now: whoosh, whoosh.

note.zh: 高血鉀處理完；尿色要盯

guide.en: A critical value from the lab

sub.zh: 阿珍：「12 床鉀離子危急值，請複誦。」
sub.en: Chen: "Bed 12, critical potassium. Read it back, please."

lines.zh: 12 床蕭伯，鉀離子危急值偏高，請複誦。
lines.en: Bed 12, Uncle Hsiao, critical high potassium. Read it back, please.

lines.zh: 複誦：12 床，鉀離子危急值偏高。
lines.en: Reading back: bed 12, critical high potassium.

lines.zh: 監視器上 T 波變得又高又尖，接著跳出一串早期收縮。
lines.en: On the monitor the T waves rise tall and peaked, then a run of ectopic beats.

options.zh: 叫人、心電圖，依醫囑處理高血鉀
options.en: Call help, ECG, treat potassium per protocol

why.zh: 對。再灌流把缺血肌肉的鉀沖回全身。先穩定心臟、再把鉀移回細胞、再排出，全部依流程，接著重抽。
why.en: Right. Reperfusion has washed the muscle's potassium into the blood. Protect the heart, shift and remove the potassium per protocol, then recheck.

why.zh: 有危急值、有尖 T 波、有早期收縮，三個加起來不是干擾。
why.en: A critical value, peaked T waves and ectopics together are not artefact.

why.zh: 高血鉀的心律不整可以在很短時間內惡化成心跳停止。
why.en: Hyperkalaemic arrhythmias can deteriorate to cardiac arrest very quickly.

post.zh: 再灌流的帳單來了。下一張是尿：看顏色、看量。
post.en: Here's the bill for reperfusion. Next invoice is the urine: colour and volume.

guide.en: Check urine colour and the foot

lines.zh: 尿袋顏色偏深，像淡茶。我記下尿量，跟醫師說。
lines.en: The urine is dark, like weak tea. I'm charting the volume and telling the doctor.

lines.zh: 腳背溫了，界線往下移到腳踝以下。腳背脈搏摸得到。
lines.en: The foot is warm; the line has moved down below the ankle. Foot pulse palpable.

lines.zh: 里程標往回走了。
lines.en: The milepost is going backwards.

lines.zh: 尿像淡茶，可能是橫紋肌溶解。補液依醫囑，抽肌酸激酶，追腎功能和尿量。
lines.en: Tea-coloured urine: possible rhabdomyolysis. Fluids per protocol, send creatine kinase, follow kidney function and output.

lines.zh: 肌紅素傷腎是安靜的。今天不抓，三天後就是洗腎的問題。
lines.en: Myoglobin harms the kidneys quietly. Miss it today and in three days it's a dialysis question.

note.zh: 腳溫了；夜裡要每小時摸小腿
note.en: Foot warm; calf checks hourly tonight

lines.zh: 交班時，夜班要知道哪三件事？
lines.en: What three things must the night team know?

lines.zh: 腳背脈搏、鉀離子和尿、小腿的腔室症候群。
lines.en: Foot pulse; potassium and urine; compartment syndrome in the calf.

lines.zh: 腔室症候群怎麼早一點抓到？
lines.en: How do you catch compartment syndrome early?

lines.zh: 痛得比傷口該有的更厲害，被動扳腳趾就劇痛，小腿摸起來繃緊。
lines.en: Pain out of proportion to the wound, agony on passively stretching the toes, a tense calf.

guide.zh: 洪主治提起早上的電話
guide.en: Dr Hung brings up the morning call

lines.zh: 早上你在電話裡叫他們把腳抬高、等大腸鏡。
lines.en: This morning you told them to elevate the leg and wait for the colonoscopy.

lines.zh: 我以為抬高可以消腫。
lines.en: I thought elevation would reduce swelling.

lines.zh: 那是靜脈的病。動脈的病，抬高是把血往山上推。
lines.en: That's venous disease. With an arterial problem, elevation pushes blood uphill.

lines.zh: 醫師，大腸鏡、抗凝血藥、貧血，接下來到底先做哪一個？
lines.en: Doctor: colonoscopy, anticoagulant, anaemia. What comes first now?

lines.zh: 肝素先繼續，避免再栓塞。腸胃科會依貧血的情況安排檢查時機，大家一起排。
lines.en: Heparin continues so no new clot breaks off. GI will time the colonoscopy around his anaemia; we plan it together.

lines.zh: 排時刻表我最會。
lines.en: Timetables are my speciality.

lines.zh: 爸，這次換我們排，你負責坐車。
lines.en: Dad, this time we do the timetable. You just ride.

guide.en: Hsuan calls: the calf is agony

sub.zh: 小萱：「蕭伯小腿痛到止痛藥都壓不住。」
sub.en: Hsuan: "Uncle Hsiao's calf pain is beating the painkillers."

lines.zh: 醫師……小腿像要爆開……腳趾一動就痛到骨頭裡。
lines.en: Doctor... my calf feels like it'll burst... moving my toes hurts to the bone.

lines.zh: 小腿繃得很緊，我輕輕扳他的腳趾，他痛到叫出來。腳背脈搏還摸得到。
lines.en: The calf is rock-tight; gently stretching his toes makes him cry out. Foot pulse still present.

q.zh: 脈搏還在，但小腿繃緊、被動伸展劇痛，你會？
q.en: Pulse present, but a tense calf and agony on passive stretch. You...?

options.zh: 叫主治，準備緊急筋膜切開

why.zh: 對。腔室症候群是臨床診斷，脈搏還在不代表沒事。拖到脈搏消失，肌肉已經壞了。
why.en: Right. Compartment syndrome is a clinical diagnosis, and a pulse does not exclude it. Wait till the pulse goes and the muscle is already dead.

options.zh: 脈搏還在，加止痛藥觀察
options.en: Pulse is there; more analgesia and watch

why.zh: 脈搏是最後才消失的。止痛藥壓住的是警訊，不是壓力。
why.en: The pulse is the last thing to go. Painkillers silence the warning, not the pressure.

options.en: Elevate the leg to reduce swelling

why.zh: 抬高會讓灌流壓更低，讓缺血更糟。
why.en: Elevation lowers the perfusion pressure and worsens the ischaemia.

post.zh: （電話）我二十分鐘內到。開刀房、麻醉都通知了嗎？
post.en: (on the phone) I'll be there within the half hour. Theatre and anaesthesia told?

post.zh: 都通知了。家屬也打過電話了。
post.en: Both told. And I've phoned the family.

lines.zh: 午夜前，小腿兩側的筋膜切開，鼓脹的肌肉鬆了下來，是粉紅色的。
lines.en: Before midnight both sides of the calf are opened; the bulging muscle relaxes, and it is pink.

lines.zh: ……醫師，幾點了？
lines.en: ...Doctor, what time is it?

lines.zh: 你的懷錶說，十一點五十二分。腿還在。
lines.en: Your watch says eight minutes to midnight. The leg is still here.

lines.zh: 值班結束。畫在皮膚上的那條線，已經在腳趾尖了。
lines.en: End of shift. The line on his skin has reached the tips of his toes.

sub.zh: 懷錶記得時間，腿留住了
sub.en: The watch kept the time; the leg was kept
